stem: Which circuit is NOT a complete circuit?
visual_elements: Circuit A shows a battery connected to a light bulb and a switch, with the switch in an open position breaking the circuit.
Circuit B shows a battery connected directly to a single light bulb with two wires.
Circuit C shows a battery connected to three light bulbs and a switch, all connected in series forming a closed loop.
Circuit D shows a battery connected to three light bulbs with multiple wire connections forming a closed loop.
